verses.1: In those years, four hundred years passed before the children of Israel could leave Egypt. It was the fourth year of King Solomon’s reign over Israel. In that year, and on the second month of that year, the Temple was built for Yahweh.
verses.2: And the house that King Solomon built for Yahweh was sixty amahs long, forty amahs wide, and thirty amahs high.
verses.3: And the wall on the front of the inner room was forty amahs in length, along the entire width of the room. It was ten amahs wide.
verses.4: And he made for the garden enclosed walls that were tightly sealed.
verses.5: And he built a fence around the walls of the house. He set up fences around the rooms and the storage areas. He also made sidewalks around those areas.
verses.6: The bottom part is five cubits in width, the middle part is six cubits in width, and the third part is seven cubits in width. This is because from the edges of the room, a surrounding space was created around it, so that nothing could be trapped between the walls of the room.
verses.7: And the house, with its decorations, was made of steel. There were no noises heard in the house during its construction.
verses.8: The opening of the lower side, towards the right-hand rib cage. From there, they will climb up to the upper side. And from the upper side, they will reach the thirty-sixth level.
verses.9: And he built the house, and he completed it. He also covered the roof and walls of the house with cypress trees.
verses.10: And he built the roof over all the house in five days. He also secured the house with cypress branches.
verses.11: And the words of Jehovah were spoken to Solomon, as follows:
verses.12: This house that you are building, if you obey my laws and carry out my judgments, and if you keep all my commandments, then I will establish my words with you. These are the words I spoke to your father David.
verses.13: And I have taken refuge among the children of Israel. I will not leave my people, Israel, ever again.
verses.14: And Solomon built the house, and he completed it.
verses.15: And he built the walls of the house from the trunks of cypress trees, starting from the ground level of the house all the way up to the walls of the sanctuary. He also planted trees around the house, and he covered the ground of the house with branches.
verses.16: And he built twenty cubits of a structure from the beams of oak wood, from the ground up to the walls. He also built a passage from the house to the holy place where the sacred things were kept.
verses.17: And forty cubits was the length of that house; it was the room in front.
verses.18: And inside the house, there were trees covered with broken branches and dead branches. There wasn’t a single visible tree at all.
verses.19: And he prepared food inside the house, so that he could offer it there as an offering to Jehovah.
verses.20: And before the altar, it was forty meters long, forty meters wide, and forty meters high. Its surface was covered with gold, and it was also covered with bronze.
verses.21: And Solomon covered the inside of the temple with gold. He also used gold to cover the doors in front of the altar.
verses.22: And all the house was covered with gold, down to the very bottom of the house. And all the altar that was used for sacrifices was also covered with gold.
verses.23: And he made two large cedars from cypress wood, each measuring twelve amotes in length.
verses.24: And five hours are from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other wing. And ten hours are from the tips of its wings.
verses.25: And twelve amasses from one unit, and one rate for the two accumulations.
verses.26: The distance between one “kruv” is twelve amahs. The same goes for the second “kruv”.
verses.27: And he placed the wings inside the inner room. Then he spread out the wings of the bird. One wing touched the wall, and the other wing of the bird also touched the second wall. Their wings continued to touch each other as they moved along the walls of the room.
verses.28: And he cast the gold coins into the pot.
verses.29: And all the walls of the house were covered with holes, like tiny holes made by arrows. There were also holes in the front and sides of the walls.
verses.30: And the floor of the house was covered with gold on both sides.
verses.31: And the door of the chest was made from cedar wood; its doors were made of cedar wood, and they were hinged together.
verses.32: And two doors of cedar wood were set up upon them; on those doors were placed nails made of gold. Gold was also used to cover the nails and the other parts of the structure.
verses.33: And he also made doors for the temple, using cedar wood from half of it.
verses.34: And there are two doors made of cedar wood. One door has two sides, while the other door also has two sides.
verses.35: And he carved out cherubsim and seraphim, along with golden decorations on the surfaces.
verses.36: And he built the inner courtyard, with three rows of columns made of cypress wood, and one row of columns made of oak wood.
verses.37: In the fourth year, the House of God was established in Yerach Ziv.
verses.38: And in the twelfth year of that year, on the eighth day of the month, it became the eighth new year. Then the house was completed, with all its elements and all its laws. It took seven years to build it.
